services.name: Render_BeginPaletteTransition
services.behavior: Selects palette source bands, snapshots the current 64-word VDP palette, and runs 16 VBlank-paced service frames with a palette step after each frame.

services.name: Frame_RunServicePassResetPhase
services.behavior: Sets FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER to 0xFF and enters the shared transition service pass.

services.name: Frame_RunServicePass
services.behavior: Advances FRAME_PHASE_COUNTER, services MovementVM and AnimationVM, builds actor-only records, waits for VBlank, and submits both sprite stages.

services.name: Render_BuildActorRecordsOnly
services.behavior: Builds camera-relative actor records from all 32 actor slots using the existing renderer output pointer, without reseeding the player/status records.

services.name: Render_ApplyPaletteStep
services.behavior: Moves each active palette word toward the selected transition palette by component group, writes the new palette to VDP, and updates the palette-band pointers.

services.name: SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit
services.behavior: Extracts one decimal digit from D3 using the divisor in D4, emits the digit through VDP_WriteTileWord, and returns the remaining value.

services.name: SceneTransition_WriteMillionsDigit
services.behavior: Sets the decimal divisor to 1,000,000 and delegates to SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit.

services.name: SceneTransition_WriteHundredThousandsDigit
services.behavior: Sets the decimal divisor to 100,000 and delegates to SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit.

services.name: SceneTransition_WriteTenThousandsDigit
services.behavior: Sets the decimal divisor to 10,000 and delegates to SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit.

services.name: SceneTransition_WriteThousandsDigit
services.behavior: Sets the decimal divisor to 1,000 and delegates to SceneTransition_WriteDecimalDigit.

conclusion: Transition rendering uses a shared service frame with a reset-phase entry, actor-only record construction, sprite submission, and a separate 64-word palette convergence step.
